itineraries.summary: Sorelle experienced Mongolia with Follow The Tracks, billed as the first self-drive 4x4 trip through the country, focused on getting off the tourist track and immersed in local culture rather than Instagram-famous spots. The trip included stays with local nomad families, Eagle Hunting families and camel-breeding families, plus the Gobi Desert, White Stupa and Flaming Cliffs. Not day-by-day, so days and per-day sequencing are unknown.
itineraries.title: Mysterious Mongolia: self-drive 4x4 adventure with Follow The Tracks

items.details: Boutique hotel on a hillside overlooking the water near Hora, Mykonos; stayed four nights. Big lunch at the hotel's excellent restaurant with friends - fresh seafood such as marinated octopus and ceviche; breakfast described as one of the best buffets she has experienced; meals by the pool overlooking the ocean; rooms with ocean views
items.name: Cavo Tagoo

items.details: Beautiful spot in Budva with incredible views; perfect for unwinding in the late afternoon; unexpectedly excellent Japanese food - large sushi platter, fried octopus and saffron risotto
items.name: Dukely Beach Lounge

itineraries.summary: From a Qantas Travel Insider interview, Tara Whiteman shared favourite discoveries from her Europe jaunt (Spain, Greece, Dubrovnik, Montenegro): a four-night stay at Cavo Tagoo in Mykonos and late afternoons at Dukely Beach Lounge in Budva. Fragmentary recommendations from a third-party interview, not her own itinerary post - her taramilktea.com blog is offline (domain is for sale on GoDaddy), so no fuller itinerary could be reconstructed.
itineraries.title: Tara Milk Tea's Europe trip highlights (Mykonos and Budva)

extractions.notes: No real itinerary exists: her own blog (taramilktea.com) is dead (domain for sale), and her content is primarily stylised photography. The one included record is LOW confidence - fragmentary hotel/restaurant mentions from a Qantas interview, kept honest and caveated. No days, no route structure.

Terri Lyne (~189K followers) is a national park explorer and nature photographer. Web searches surfaced only listicle mentions and nature-photography content; no guides, itineraries, day-by-day plans or named-trip posts were found. Social-search attempts timed out (infra error). Recording zero itineraries rather than forcing one.

itineraries.summary: Kiersten Rich's full day-by-day plan for two weeks in Morocco: 4 nights in Marrakech (Riad Yasmine, La Mamounia), 2 nights glamping in the Sahara Desert, 1 night in the Skoura Valley Oasis, 2 nights in Essaouira, the overnight train to Tangier, 2 nights in Chefchaouen, 1 night in Fes and a final night in Casablanca. Every stop pairs named hotels and restaurants with the specific activities she did there, plus real transport legs and costs.
itineraries.title: Itinerary for Two Weeks in Morocco

itineraries.summary: A 7-day adventure road trip through western Oregon built around one moderately strenuous hike per day, based in Bend (Days 1-4) then Portland (Days 5-7): Benham Falls, Tumalo Mountain, Sparks Lake, Tumalo Falls, Silver Falls State Park and Ramona Falls. itineraries.summary: The Broke Backpacker's 1-month route digging deeper into Southeast Asia: Bangkok, the Thai islands (Koh Tao, Koh Phangan, Koh Lanta), then Cambodia (Siem Reap/Angkor Wat, Phnom Penh, Koh Rong) and Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City, Hoi An, Da Nang, Hanoi, the Ha Giang motorbike loop and Ha Long Bay).
